6a1c00000000000000000e01 description:
Listen. There is a new crew in town and they call themselves the Bottlers. Ex-PMCs, both sides, the kind who stopped caring about flags the day the money stopped coming. They got their hands on a shipment of very strange sodas. One can makes you reload like a machine, another lets you run all day... I thought it was a fairy tale, until I saw one of them jump off a roof and walk away whistling.

They have dug in at the Reserve base, by the old rail depot. One of them carries an envelope that belongs to me: papers from a deal that went sour. Find their post, take the envelope off them and bring it here. And be careful, friend: whatever they drink, it is real.
6a1c00000000000000000e01 successMessageT: So it is true... these papers are not mine at all. Recipes, numbers, a stamp from a lab nobody talks about. Keep this between us. Take your money, and take this: with the right ingredients you can brew a couple of those sodas yourself, in your own hideout.
6a1c00000000000000000e01 startedMessageT: The Bottlers are at Reserve. Four of them, each one with a bottle in the belly. Do not let them land the first shot.
6a1c00000000000000520102: Locate the Bottlers' post at Reserve
6a1c00000000000000000e13: Hand over the sealed envelope to Skier
6a1c00000000000000510200 description:
Skier came to me with a pile of papers he did not understand. I do. These are production notes, and the stamp belongs to the old research wing of the Health Resort on the shore. Someone there was trying to make soldiers who do not tire, do not bleed, do not fall. They called the drinks perks. Ridiculous name, brilliant chemistry.

The Bottlers went back to the resort to take what was left. Their courier carries a laboratory notebook with the rest of the formula. I want that notebook. Not for them, not for Skier: for the people this city keeps breaking. Bring it to me and I will teach you two more recipes.
6a1c00000000000000510200 successMessageT: Look at these annotations... dosage, half-life, side effects. Somebody wrote 'subject flew off the balcony, laughed' in the margin. This is enough to brew Juggernog and PHD Flopper safely. The recipes are yours; use the Nutrition Unit.
6a1c00000000000000510200 startedMessageT: The Bottlers are inside the Health Resort, west wing. The courier with the notebook will not leave his friends' side.
6a1c00000000000000520202: Locate the Bottlers inside the Health Resort
6a1c00000000000000520205: Hand over the laboratory notebook to Therapist
6a1c00000000000000510300 description:
A formula is useless without a way to bottle it. The Bottlers do not brew by hand: they run a small bottling line in the Customs factory, and the schematics travel with one of their men. Get me those schematics. While you are at it, I need parts to build our own line: a printed circuit board, two silicone tubes and a car battery.

When this is done, the city will have its sodas without having to beg those thugs for them.
6a1c00000000000000510300 successMessageT: Circuit board, tubes, battery and the schematics... yes. The line works. Now we can bottle the last two recipes: Widow's Wine and Deadshot Daiquiri. And now that the Bottlers know who you are, they will be waiting for you.
6a1c00000000000000510300 startedMessageT: The Bottlers' line is at the Customs factory. Bring the schematics and the parts, in any order.
6a1c00000000000000520302: Locate the Bottlers' bottling line at the Customs factory
6a1c00000000000000520305: Hand over the bottling schematics to Therapist
6a1c00000000000000520310: Hand over a printed circuit board
6a1c00000000000000510400 description:
The Bottlers who drink Speed Cola reload faster than you can blink. A squad of them is unloading crates in the OLI warehouse at Interchange, and their shipment manifest says where every can of Speed Cola goes.

Every Bottler in that squad has Speed Cola in the blood, and it shows. Bring me what their courier carries and I will finally be able to sell Speed Cola myself, fresh and safe, to anyone who needs it.
6a1c00000000000000510400 successMessageT: This is it. With this I can bottle Speed Cola in my own clinic. From today you will find it on my shelf. Thank you, and drink responsibly.
6a1c00000000000000510400 startedMessageT: Expect long bursts and very short reloads. Fight them at range, or do not fight them at all.
6a1c00000000000000520402: Locate the Bottlers' Speed Cola squad
6a1c00000000000000520404: Find the Speed Cola shipment manifest
6a1c00000000000000520405: Hand over the Speed Cola shipment manifest to Therapist

6a1c00000000000000510a00 description:
You have been busy, friend. Therapist sells the sodas now, the Bottlers are bleeding, and their boss is not happy. They call him the Bartender. He drinks every perk they ever brewed, all at once, and he has holed up in the underground command post at Reserve with his last loyal men.

He keeps the master formula on him, the original, the one everything else was copied from. Kill him, take it, and bring it to me. After that, the Bottlers are a story people tell around barrels. And you will be the one who ended it.
6a1c00000000000000510a00 successMessageT: The master formula. Hah! I will sell copies to everyone and nobody will ever corner this market again. Here, a little thank-you from the both of us: a crate of every soda and enough coins to make the Bartender cry, if he still could.
6a1c00000000000000510a00 startedMessageT: The Bartender is in the Reserve command bunker. Every perk at once: he hits hard, runs fast, takes a beating and does not care about grenades. Bring friends, or a plan.
6a1c00000000000000520a02: Locate the Bartender's hideout at Reserve
6a1c00000000000000520a05: Hand over the master formula to Skier
